I am still importing this information from Sohini's github but as soon as she has decided the information is correct, I can think about moving this to my repository or use the link to hers 


```{r data import,echo=Generating the ML tree}

## THESE FILES WERE MADE BY SOHINI 

tree<-read.tree(here("Data_input", "Genome", "AVT_single_copy_core_concat_outgroup.fasta.treefile")) ### I am using a file that I saw Sohini updated like 11 hours ago, is this the right one? I don' tknow, it says unrooted so I can not run teh statistical test. 
tree

## Extract the strains in the tree which represents what Sohini used. 
tip_strains <- data.frame(Strain = tree$tip.label)
tip_strains <- tip_strains %>% dplyr::rename(Strain_Code = Strain)
tip_strains
## Add the informaiton I am interested in particularly Morphology 

Strains <- read_excel(here("Data_input", "Strains_Description_Phenotype.xlsx"))
Strains ## I will use Morphology and Pairs

meta_tree <- left_join(tip_strains, Strains, by = "Strain_Code") #Making sure none of the tip samples were lost after left_joining with the "Strains" metadata

meta_tree

```

### Create the files for itols 


```{r}

dir.create(here("Tables", "itol_annotations"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# FILE 1: labels.txt  

## The labels are in the format 001, 002, 003... 

labels <- data.frame(
  tip = meta_tree$Strain_Code,
  new_label = meta_tree$Strain
)
labels <- labels[!is.na(labels$tip) & !is.na(labels$new_label), ]
labels


cat("LABELS\nSEPARATOR TAB\n\nDATA\n",
    file = here("Tables", "itol_annotations", "labels.txt"))

write.table(labels, here("Tables", "itol_annotations", "labels.txt"),
            sep = "\t", append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)


## Morphology

# FILE 2: morphology_colorstrip.txt

# Edit these two colors to change Morphology appearance
morph_colors <- c("Mucoid" = "#4eadb9", "Dry" = "#e0ba3e")
  
morphology <- data.frame(
    tip   = meta_tree$Strain,
    color = morph_colors[as.character(meta_tree$Morphology)],
    label = meta_tree$Morphology
  )

morphology <- morphology[!is.na(morphology$color), ]
morphology

cat(
    "DATASET_COLORSTRIP\n",
    "SEPARATOR TAB\n",
    "DATASET_LABEL\tMorphology\n",
    "COLOR\t#000000\n",
    "STRIP_WIDTH\t25\n",
    "LEGEND_TITLE\tMorphology\n",
    "LEGEND_SHAPES\t1\t1\n",
    "LEGEND_COLORS\t", morph_colors["Mucoid"], "\t", morph_colors["Dry"], "\n",
    "LEGEND_LABELS\tMucoid\tDry\n",
    "\nDATA\n",
    sep = "",
    file = here("Tables", "itol_annotations", "morphology_colorstrip.txt")
  )
write.table(morphology, here("Tables", "itol_annotations", "morphology_colorstrip.txt"),
              sep = "\t", append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
              col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)


# FILE 3: pairs_colorstrip.txt   (colored boxes + pair numbers)

# One color per pair; use rainbow() so many pairs stay distinguishable
pair_ids    <- sort(unique(na.omit(as.character(meta_tree$Pairs))))
pair_colors <- setNames(rainbow(length(pair_ids)), pair_ids)

pairs <- data.frame(
  tip   = meta_tree$Strain,
  color = pair_colors[as.character(meta_tree$Pairs)],
  label = meta_tree$Pairs
)
pairs <- pairs[!is.na(pairs$color), ]

cat(
  "DATASET_COLORSTRIP\n",
  "SEPARATOR TAB\n",
  "DATASET_LABEL\tPairs\n",
  "COLOR\t#000000\n",
  "STRIP_WIDTH\t40\n",
  "SHOW_STRIP_LABELS\t1\n",
  "STRIP_LABEL_SIZE_FACTOR\t0.9\n",
  "STRIP_LABEL_OUTLINE\t0.5\n",
  "\nDATA\n",
  sep = "",
  file = here("Tables", "itol_annotations", "pairs_colorstrip.txt")
)
write.table(pairs, here("Tables", "itol_annotations", "pairs_colorstrip.txt"),
            sep = "\t", append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

## SNP differences between pairs

```{r}

raw_lines <- read_lines("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sohini5981/AVT_SS/refs/heads/main/Data/strain_118_variants_pairwise_mismatches.tsv?token=GHSAT0AAAAAAEB5NZNJGLKKLM2RIHBBHF4W2SNWXSQ")

# Keep only the actual data rows (they start with "DCv2", not "#DCv2" or "INFO")
data_lines <- raw_lines[startsWith(raw_lines, "DCv2")]

gtcheck_data <- read_tsv(
  I(data_lines),   # I() tells read_tsv to treat this as literal text, not a filepath
  col_names = c("Tag", "Query_Sample", "Genotyped_Sample", "Discordance",
                "Avg_neg_log_P_HWE", "Sites_compared", "Matching_genotypes")
)
View(gtcheck_data)
gtcheck_data <- gtcheck_data %>% dplyr::select(-Tag)

View(gtcheck_data)


```

Assessing the phylogenetic signal

```{r}
install.packages("caper")
library(caper)

## Convert dry and mucoid in 0/1

meta_tree <- meta_tree %>%
  mutate(Dry_binary = if_else(Morphology == "Dry", 1, 0))

comp_data <- comparative.data(phy = tree,
                                data = meta_tree,
                                names.col = "Strain_Code",
                                vcv = TRUE)

d_result <- phylo.d(comp_data, binvar = Dry_binary)  # Dry_binary should be 0/1
print(d_result)
plot(d_result)


```
